newsitem.title: USA: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA wheat export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales activity for the 1997/98 marketing year (MY), which began June 1, totaled 562,500 metric tons (MT). The major increases were reported for Egypt (265,000 MT), Mexico (81,200 MT), Japan (73,800 MT), Turkey (25,000 MT), Iraq (25,000 MT), and Ecuador (24,800 MT). Decreases were reported for unknown destinations (27,500 MT).

A total of 1,005,900 MT in sales were carried over from the 1996/97 MY, which ended May 31. Exports of 112,700 MT for the period May 30-31 brought accumulated exports to 25,964,100 MT, down 21 percent from 32,918,100 MT exported during 1995/96.
Exports for June 1-5 totaled 279,300 MT, with Japan (54,200 MT), Pakistan (39,900 MT), Ecuador (29,800 MT), the Philippines (28,200 MT), and South Korea (28,200 MT) the primary destinations.
